@category: Outdoor • Environmental
@skills: Caving, Foraging, Hunting, Star-gazing,
@restricted: —
@stat_bonuses: SD/In/Me
@rank_progression: Standard
@category_progression: Standard
@group: Outdoor
@classification: Static Maneuver
@description:
 Survival, Weather Watching This category encompasses the use of skills
 involving information-gathering and surviving in the outdoors and other
 unusual environments. These skills may range from gathering food to
 understanding how best to resist extreme heat or cold.

# ===================================================================
# SKILL DESCRIPTIONS
# ===================================================================

@@ Caving (Spelunking)
@stat: Me
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for determining natural course lay of a cave or
 cavern (passage or chamber). Bonus when attempting an unassisted maneuver
 in a cave.: +25

@@ Foraging
@stat: Em
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for finding any local source potable water or
 edible plants and animals. Includes basic food acquisition such as
 gathering or fishing.

@@ Hunting
@stat: Em
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus to hunting maneuvers. Note tracking and
 recognizing game is covered by other skills; this skill gives bonuses to
 the actual hunt, including setting up blind runs, leading and driving game,
 etc.

@@ Star-gazing
@stat: Me
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for determining dates, directions, and
 locations when the stars are visible. May provide a bonus one’s navigation
 skills.

@@ Survival
@stat: In
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for living in a specific dangerous hostile
 environment. Note that this skill encompasses only those methods needed to
 stay alive against the actively dangerous elements of an environment (e.g.,
 blistering heat, cold, pressure, unusual animals typical of the
 environment, etc.). It does include food gathering, although it does
 include the knowledge necessary to find water. Skill must be developed in
 each type environment (e.g., desert, jungle, arctic, water, etc.). The GM
 may rule that unusually hostile environments may also be covered by this
 skill (e.g., vacuum, underwater, elemental planes fire, etc.).

@@ Weather Watching
@stat: In
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for determining local weather next 24 hours.
